Source-bound delegated wallet owner.

Verification service only; authoritative status with expiry/revocation; idempotent update.
Domain authority with delegated wallet owner, accepted evidence and policy. Durable Idempotency-Key; conflicting fingerprints rejected. Test mode only.
Original source service and delegated wallet owner.
Original source service and delegated wallet owner. Idempotent economic effect; read-back validates reference/amount/currency/merchant/intent/mode. Does not settle or release funds.

Domain authority with delegated wallet owner; consent and authoritative KYC, approved test merchant. Idempotent by wallet/provider with fingerprint; repeat unknown customer request performs read-back.
Source-bound delegated wallet owner; masked account only.
Domain authority with delegated owner. Provider identification before assignment; requery/fetch for existing account. Unknown assignment uses read-back.
Domain authority with delegated owner; provider deactivation followed by status read-back.
Admin service only; audit evidence required; active worker lease cannot be overridden; original references retained.
Admin service only; raw merchant observations never represented as individual wallet money or licensed custody.
Admin service only; external merchant balance read-back; mismatches restrict the pool and publish an exception.
Admin service only; immutable external settlement batch observation. Does not credit settled cash or change an intent to SETTLED.
Admin service only; evidence and policy required. Restoration requires two distinct recorded approvers. Closure rejects outstanding liabilities/intents and retains history.

Verification service only; current authoritative verification, exact beneficiary reference, jurisdiction and expiry. Records bank verification only; no financial entitlement or payout execution. Eligible remains false.
Source-bound delegated wallet owner; bank reference only, no raw bank details. Recording a reference does not authorize withdrawals.
All 18 disabled blueprint templates; no tariff or legal deadline is supplied.
Admin only; immutable approved jurisdiction/contract/product/effective version. Deactivated versions remain historical.
Signed caller; resolve an approved effective policy for exact jurisdiction, currency, contract and product.
Admin only; append an evidenced effective deactivation without editing accepted policy history.
Signed caller; historical policy version.
Authoritative domain; ownership percentages verified by owner/business; manager fee mandates issued by owner/business only; platform requires Admin.
Original issuer or Admin; irreversible evidenced revocation.
Original business domain; immutable full accepted quote, payer consent and components. Idempotency-Key required.
Original source or delegated payer only.
Original source or payer; component classification and current financial facts. Deposits remain separate.
Original canonical quote source only; exact reconciliation, verified current beneficiary authority, immutable version. Unreleased corrections compensate the previous journal.
Original source or owned beneficiary lines only; unrelated allocations are filtered.
Original source or Admin; independent share hold. Clearing requires two distinct approvers. Idempotency-Key required.
Policy-permitted authenticated evidence authority; bound to allocation/condition/version and expiry. HTTP source cannot be supplied by user data.
Original source or Admin; required evidence, actual matched funding, restrictions and custody requirements; capped atomic partial release. Idempotency-Key required.
Admin with two finance approvers; provider settlement membership and liquidity readback plus reconciled cash attestation. Test mode only; merchant balance is not lawful custody proof.
Verification only; bank owner and payout reference attested, recipient readback validates provider/merchant/mode/currency. Immutable binding.
Admin only; exact beneficiary/amount/destination, authoritative step-up and risk references, threshold approvals, expiry; single-use.
Delegated beneficiary domain only; AVAILABLE-only, atomic reservation, approved test payout capability, one original-provider attempt. Idempotency-Key required.
Delegated wallet owner or Admin; unconfirmed external results remain reserved.
Delegated owner or Admin; original-reference provider readback. Unknown never releases money or resubmits; definitive no-effect failure compensates safely.
Owner/business authority only; immutable accepted agreement/version, fixed or continuing term, separately contracted owner commission/manager fee and components.
Owner/business authority; manually commanded exact period/due date; unique non-overlapping obligation, eligible recurrence only, separate deposit stream. No automatic charge.
Original source or payer; immutable terms plus current payment status.
Original source; configured owner-side commission and mandate-specific fee, exact co-owner arithmetic, deposit separated.
Admin-authorized dead-letter replay retains the original provider/reference and immutable retry history. Never submits money.

Admin dual authority/current evidence. Assignment binds original beneficiary; recovery uses only approved internal reserve or liable-party retained proceeds. Original debt and history remain immutable. Idempotency-Key required.
Privileged Admin dual approval, reason/evidence and policy-bounded expiry; review authority only, no ledger or closed-case rewrite.
Admin dual authority; follow-up reconciliation must clear the exact finding. Append resolution without deleting original exceptions or correcting money.

Original canonical quote source or Admin plus current cancellation policy/evidence. Only unsubmitted REQUESTED intents may become CANCELLED. Collected money requires approved case/refund. Idempotency-Key required.
Admin-approved immutable jurisdiction deadlines, remedy strategies, cooling and customer funding/spend controls.
